# @bookklik/senangstart-icons

Curated Starter icons designed for web projects.

Version: 1.0.17
License: MIT

## Usage

### Node.js / Bundlers (Webpack, Vite, etc.)

1. Install the package:
   ```bash
   npm i @bookklik/senangstart-icons
   ```

2. Import icons:
   
   **ES Modules (Recommended):**
   ```js
   import icons from '@bookklik/senangstart-icons/icons';
   
   const { "arrow-right": ArrowRight, "user": User } = icons;
   ```

   **CommonJS:**
   ```js
   const icons = require('@bookklik/senangstart-icons/icons');
   
   const { "arrow-right": ArrowRight, "user": User } = icons;
   ```

### Web Components

1. Include the script:
   ```html
   <script src="https://unpkg.com/@bookklik/senangstart-icons/dist/senangstart-icon.min.js"></script>
   ```

2. Use the component:
   ```html
   <ss-icon icon="icon-slug"></ss-icon>
   <!-- Default stroke width: 2. Optional custom thickness: -->
   <ss-icon icon="icon-slug" thickness="1.5"></ss-icon>
   ```

### CSS Icons

1. Include the CSS:
   ```html
   <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@bookklik/senangstart-icons/dist/senangstart.min.css">
   ```

2. Use the class:
   ```html
   <i class="ss ss-icon-slug"></i>
   ```
